summary:
Main
Today's market showed a seaborne recovery alongside softer port prices rather than broad-based strength. The 61% seaborneindex rose to USD 89.80/dmt and the 65% to 109.50, while all 12 brand quotations gained USD 0.55-0.60. DCE most-traded edged up to 683.0 yuan/mt, but the 61%, 58% and 65% port indices fell to 661, 622 and 824 yuan/wmt.
